newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures rally, led by Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures rally, led by Nasdaq.

text.p: May 5 - U.S. stock index futures rallied in afternoon trading, with June S&Ps sharply higher in sync with Nasdaq gains. Traders said the tech-laden index led S&Ps higher. "Nasdaq turned right around on a dime," one trader said. June S&P poked above ceiling at 823.60 Mar 11 high. Contract high at 827.80.
